MT7IaTzzwY4.p2_en: In this match debrief, Haris Nenmara reviews the historic El Clasico clash between Real Madrid and Barcelona at Camp Nou. Grounded directly in the complete broadcast transcript, this breakdown examines Jose Mourinho's defensive structure, Mesut Özil's through-pass, and Cristiano Ronaldo's iconic calm celebration that sealed a decisive La Liga victory.
takeaways: Jose Mourinho's tactical preparation and Real Madrid's dynamic transition speed

Mesut Özil's through-pass setting up Cristiano Ronaldo's match-winning finish
Real Madrid's defensive discipline resisting Barcelona's possession game
